notes.title: ghostpia: Season One gets a physical release on Nintendo Switch™!
notes.content:
Hello, Chosuido here.
We're ghostpia's dev team.
First of all, thank you for always liking our news and leaving us lots of delightful comments.

We have some very good news today.
ghostpia: Season One is getting a physical release for Nintendo Switch™ on March 13th, 2025!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153447/f9819c29a3a9f9e046a8dfc6f361a3e8c6a5e89f.jpg

The game itself is the same as in the digital versions for both Nintendo Switch™ and Steam, but, as it's the first time ghostpia is released in a physical format, we've included some nice extras in the first edition, so that people who have already played the game can enjoy it too.
If you're interested, you can preorder it right now!

New Illustrated Three-Fold cover

With the physical version of the game, you'll get a three-fold cover inspired by that unforgettable scene in chapter two.
It's a wonderful, never-before-seen illustration by the game's illustrator, Yamamoto Suzume.

Ghost Secret Documents - Chapter: Me and Chapter: Night
We're also including a special double pamphlet: Ghost Secret Documents.
You can store this in the aforementioned three-fold cover alongside the game itself.

The first part of the pamphlet is "Chapter: Night", an artbook made of beautiful illustrations showcasing ghostpia's history.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153447/e52cf6a1b1cdb1aeb30841ab78067dc09d5b8233.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153447/d251f03333ec4b6ddb74e4f0c4894317be848503.jpg

The second part includes "ghostpia: Season NaN", the pilot version of the game's scenario that we wrote before ever starting on the ghostpia's development, and "Chapter: Me", a special companion story that takes place after the events of chapter five and shows a day in the life Sayoko.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153447/9c3c9896b581509ec7a2267d11b3da43c98a9ad6.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153447/f582d716178d73df76d257c2f709599cc38db6e6.jpg

Not to toot our own horn, but they're both pretty good. They'd make a great addition to your ghostpia collection.

On the cover of Chapter: Me, you'll find a secret URL and a secret password that will bring you to a special page with more bonuses: downloadable illustrations and a web version of Chapter: Me.
Unfortunately, because of time constraints, the physical version of the pamphlet will only be available in Japanese. We're talking with the publisher to at least have the web version translated. (If, for some reason, that doesn't work out... you could at least run the Japanese web version through your browser's automatic translation, we guess?)

As for all our overseas fan, there are a few import shops that will sell the game outside of Japan. We know it's not ideal, but we hope that, if you want this physical version, you'll be able to get it like that.

Oh, apart from all that, you'll also get a film-reel-style translucent bookmark as a nifty bonus!

Depending on the store, you may also receive some extra preorder bonuses.
Check out the special Nintendo Switch™ physical version page for more details.

ghostpia @ Akihabara!

Lastly, we'd like to share our excitement in seeing ghostpia commercials out in the wild for the game's physical release.
One was even broadcast on the huge screen in front of Akihabara station—Akihabara being kind of a sacred town for Japanese entertainment content.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153447/a21f812e930a224e4cc67bb7f3bf546a83e15139.jpg

Once we find more commercials in the wild, we'll probably post them on our official X account. So, please follow us there!

Now that we're done with the news, let us end this by thanking all of you once again for all the support you've shown for our little team and ghostpia.
-Chosuido

notes.title: ghostpia: Season One has sold 10,000 copies!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone.
This is Chosuido, the development team behind ghostpia: Season One.

We're writing to celebrate a milestone we are very happy about.

Counting all platforms and regions, ghostpia: Season One has now sold over 10,000 copies!


Knowing that 10,000 people all over the world have bought and played our game fills us with joy!

To celebrate, ghostpia's illustrator, Yamamoto Suzume, has drawn a brand-new illustration never seen before!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153447/98a37e9ff231157b2ae630ecedbcb81702ea4a42.png

Even though they got such a nice cake to celebrate the 10,000 copies, they're eating it sitting on the ground. That's just what you'd expect from them, and you can't help but smile.

Of course, compared to the legends in the world of visual novels, 10,000 copies is nothing. But to us, it's a goal worthy of gratitude and celebration.

The most marketable sub-genre within visual novels is that of romance sims. You know, the ones where you choose a girl and try to romance her. But ghostpia, even though it's a Japanese indie visual novel, doesn't fit into that category, which doesn't make it easy to sell.
At first, we were honestly scared that we wouldn't even sell 100 copies. This is why this achievement makes us so happy.

(To be honest, most of the sales are actually from countries other than Japan, which is extremely surprising but also made us very happy. If you're reading this news in one of its translated versions, thank you!)

Let's talk about the past for a bit.

This happened a while ago, sometime around 2009...

Chosuido had just come together. We, as high-schoolers, participated in an event where people come together to sell their indie stuff.
Back then, online platforms weren't as popular as they are now, and people still sold games by burning them on CDs at home.

There was a huge crowd at the event, and we Chosuido members, young and hopeful, thought that with all that people, we were bound to sell at least a few dozens of copies.
We manned our booth from morning till night, and the day was over before we realized it.

The grand total of sales was... zero.
The truth was obvious: just because there are a lot of people, it doesn't mean that they'll buy your game. They have to actually feel interested in it.
This, in turn, made us realize another thing: this result meant that nobody was interested in our game.

Crushed and dejected, we still had the force to promise ourselves that we would try making something even better that people would be interested in. Now, we wish we could go back in time and comfort our past-selves by telling them that their long efforts were not in vain.
Our first effort led to no sales at all, but now, with ghostpia, we reached 10,000, and we hope to make it to 15,000 or even 20,000 one day.
Thank you for reading this boring old story.

Chosuido today and tomorrow

Right now, we at Chosuido are hard at work making ghostpia: Season Two.
We're a small team of four people working in Tokyo, Japan. (And not working exclusively on ghostpia either, since we all have fulltime jobs.)

Developing a game like ghostpia takes a lot of time, and we aren't exactly the fastest to begin with.
We're sorry to make you wait, but we want to deliver you something that is well worth the wait. Thank you for your patience. Maybe leave us a comment on X if you feel like it.

That was all from Chosuido.
Thank you for all your love for ghostpia: Season One.

Chosuido

notes.title: Complete ghostpia Short Stories Now in Simplified & Traditional Chinese!
notes.content:
Hello,
This is Chousuidou, the production team for ghostpia Season One.

※This article was originally written in Japanese and has been translated into English via machine translation. Therefore, we apologize if there are any unnatural expressions. However, please rest assured that the in-game text has been translated by a highly reliable translator.

We're here with a follow-up to the news we shared last month.

https://steamcommunity.com/games/2192620/announcements/detail/4024598238785500711

Continuing from the three stories previously released, we're excited to announce the translation of two more novels into Simplified and Traditional Chinese. 

(For those of you reading this in English, we apologize for the announcement that is not very relevant! We continue to hope that an English translation will be arranged as soon as possible, as long as quality and cost can be compromised.) 

https://ghostpia.xyz/novel/

These original contents serve as spin-offs to the main story, filling in gaps and telling tales not depicted in the main narrative.

『9999年のゴースト・サマー』
https://ghostpia.xyz/zh_cn/novel/gaiden4


Sayoko gets involved in Pacifica's business and is invited to a resort pool recreating "summer". Ghosts in the town buzz with this rare, fresh entertainment, where Sayoko discovers an unexpected vulnerability...

『ニンジャ、閉架の父に遭う』
https://ghostpia.xyz/zh_cn/novel/gaiden5


One day, Yoru feels the strain of running out of fake psychoanalytical terms at his psychoanalysis stand. He's advised to visit the town's library, only to find a half-destroyed building. There, they encounter a mysterious old man who often appears before Sayoko and others. Under the old man's guidance, Sayoko and Yoru end up working as "library part-timers"...

Please enjoy this spin-off series that has also been well-received in Japan, now in Simplified and Traditional Chinese. We would be delighted if you could read them alongside the main story to further immerse yourself in the world of ghostpia. (While there are no current plans for additional novel releases, we hope to share more news with you should that change!)

https://ghostpia.xyz/novel

notes.title: Enjoy ghostpia: Season One on the Steam Deck!
notes.content:
Hello,
Chosuido here with some good news about ghostpia: Season One.

ghostpia was first released on Steam in August of last year. How time flies! It's been half a year already.
We've spent the last few months updating the game to improve, among other things, performance.
One of the major updates in that time was the inclusion of Chinese localization.
However, while we were working on Season Two, we were also developing an important update... which just came out!

We're finally Steam Deck Verified!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153447/ce457435775eabaf31deabdc4cea0819dbd86450.png
With the latest update, ghostpia's Steam Deck compatibility has been changed to verified
Steam officially agrees that playing it on Steam Deck is a wonderful experience!
(To be quite honest, it worked fine to begin with, but that's another story.)

If you are the proud owner of a Steam Deck, you now have one more reason to play the game there.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2192620/ghostpia_Season_One/

Thank you for your support to ghostpia: Season One, and we hope you're looking forward to Season Two.

Chosuido

notes.title: "ghostpia Season One" Set to Release on August 22nd at 12:00 AM Pacific Time!
notes.content:
Hello! We are Chosuido, the development team behind ghostpia. Today, we have some exciting news to share with all of you.

The release date for "ghostpia Season One" has been set!
Next Tuesday, on August 22nd at 12:00 AM Pacific Time(PT), it will be available for purchase on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2192620/ghostpia/

While "ghostpia Season One" was released on the Nintendo Switch earlier this spring, the Steam version offers:

 Keyboard and mouse controls
 FHD and 4K resolution
 Performance up to 60fps
 Steam achievements

All these features are designed to provide a more luxurious experience on the larger screens of PCs.

We apologize for the long wait leading up to this release. We are thrilled to finally be able to deliver this to you. As Chosuido, this is our first release on Steam, and it has been a journey filled with challenges. We made you wait, but thanks to the overwhelming support and encouragement from all of you, we managed to reach this milestone. We are truly grateful.

Launch Sale!

For the first week after release, there will be a 15% discount. We hope you'll take advantage of this special price and enjoy the game.

Soundtrack and Artbook Release!

On the same day, the "ghostpia Season One" soundtrack "Relay" and an artbook packed with in-game art and design materials will also be available for purchase.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2536240/Relay__ghostpia__Original_Soundtrack/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2538470/ghostpia___Art_book/

Both are available at a great discount when purchased as a bundle. We hope you'll consider adding them to your collection.

In conclusion, we humbly ask for your support for the Steam release of "ghostpia Season One" on August 22nd (Tuesday). If you enjoy the game, we would be delighted if you could leave a review.

That's all for today's announcement. The release is just around the corner, and we hope you're as excited as we are. Please look forward to it!

Please be sure to follow us on our social media!
https://twitter.com/chosuido

notes.title: Meet the Developers of ghostpia!
notes.content:
※This article was originally written in Japanese and has been translated into English via machine translation. Therefore, we apologize if there are any unnatural expressions.

About Us

Hello. We are Chosuido, the creators of "ghostpia Season One".

We sincerely thank you for adding 'ghostpia Season One' to your wish lists on Steam, set to release this summer. Have you had a chance to play the currently available demo version yet?

Now, let us introduce ourselves, Chosuido, the creators of "ghostpia Season One".

Chosuido is a team mainly creating visual novels, established in 2008 by high school students. The team consists of four members in total. All are Japanese and carry out their production activities on the side, while working as company employees in Tokyo.

In producing ghostpia, in addition to the four members of Chosuido, we have enlisted guest staff to assist with programming, music, and some graphics production. (To everyone involved in the production, thank you very much!)

The Secrets of Our Art

While there are various aspects we would like to highlight about ghostpia, we believe the charm of the game is undoubtedly supported by its range of vibrant illustrations. The number of illustrations amounts to around 500, most of which are drawn by two graphic designers from Chosuido, Suzume Yamamoto and Buchi.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153447/55d35282a3e7395725a15ea56b5d7d8431b3cf02.jpg
↑This is a glimpse into the work process of Suzume Yamamoto, one of the graphic designers for the game.

Although the illustrations of ghostpia may seem quite rough at first glance, they are, in fact, carefully created following meticulous steps.

Take this striking scene for example. The rough sketch starts like this.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153447/fdbd3adcbd63a0e14921ee4540b737d0a10a57c7.jpg

With a bit more work, we move on to the draft stage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153447/4b71ef4b633f752db53d2cec648663283ae404e4.jpg

Further refining brings us to the completed line art.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153447/9cb4829a4a2fb5950f5fce722bb4cd8e43028193.jpg

The line art is processed into flat colors, preparing it for the coloring stage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153447/7bef04c9a7dbc44a47f1d27fcada3c5c161b9f81.jpg

The coloring has been done.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153447/ccb770f9079361d4fa32621372cd70851edcbffb.jpg

We've made further color adjustments. This version of the image is imported and used in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153447/a2425d7ca498596e487187f210fc15cf674aa7f8.jpg

Here's how it looks on the game screen. The atmosphere has improved dramatically, hasn't it?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153447/965836da42d54872d4c63c55f696d0afc107828c.png

We could say that an illustration for Ghostpia is completed when the glitch effect in the game is applied.These effects are constantly generated randomly, so no two moments are ever the same. (If you find it difficult to see, you can turn off the glitch effects from the settings)

We would be delighted if those who enjoy appreciating illustrations could also find pleasure in ghostpia.

"ghostpia Season One" is set to release this summer. Please look forward to further updates.

notes.title: How to change the language in "ghostpia: Season One Demo"
notes.content:
Introduction
Hello, and thank you for your interest in ghostpia: Season One. This is Chosuido, the game's development team.

ghostpia is available in both Japanese and English, but the demo's language changes automatically depending on your Steam client settings.
If you want to change the language manually, you have to follow the procedure below. Sorry for the inconvenience.
Also, in the complete version of the game, you'll be able to change the language from an in-game menu.

If you wish to change the game language for the demo, follow these steps:

1. Open your game library in the Steam client
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153447/9edca18a194d7fe39fa259f2bbc7b89717229747.jpg
Make sure that "ghostpia: Season One Demo" is in your library.


2. Select "ghostpia: Season One Demo" within the library
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153447/aaa0b85fd3ab4ec0f644006f4580d382dfb4fc99.jpg
You will see the game's preview image and the "Play" button.


3. Click on the gear icon at the bottom right of the image
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153447/3c7bf8328ec1c15827d44978dbeecf5d0eedd6a4.jpg
When you click on the gear icon, a pull-down menu will be displayed.


4. Click on "Properties" in the pull-down menu
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153447/45f3c9898a78f8cc41ac3ee9b2fee49ac59c69ca.jpg
When you click on "Properties," the Properties window will be displayed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153447/d0274ade359ba35a710e1d4db5d4c5a0208e8be1.jpg


5. Select "Language" from the menu on the left side of the window
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153447/0dd7c36d2b251c150bcf75e1cd8f92f4e76ce9ed.jpg
Once you select the "Language" tab, a pull-down box where you can choose the language will be displayed.


6. Choose the language you want to play the game in
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153447/a12fcc66a7362d46bf824fc2f673e681b5b4bd30.jpg
After selecting the desired language, you can close the Property window.


7. Play ghostpia: Season One Demo
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153447/d04b1bb4ff2f1e3d138386a4c00e366e9b5a7c14.jpg
The next time you play the game, the language will have changed.


That's all.
Have fun playing ghostpia: Season One Demo!
